title: Pig dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='91' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <rect x='58' y='72' width='9' height='16' rx='4' fill='#e0899b'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='88' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#c46b80'/>
  <!-- front leg -->
  <rect x='34' y='72' width='9' height='16' rx='4' fill='#f2a5b4'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='88' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#d97f92'/>
  <!-- arms up dancing -->
  <rect x='20' y='42' width='7' height='22' rx='3.5' fill='#f2a5b4' transform='rotate(35 23 53)'/>
  <rect x='74' y='42' width='7' height='22' rx='3.5' fill='#e0899b' transform='rotate(-35 77 53)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#f2a5b4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='18' ry='13' fill='#f9c3cd'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='20' fill='#f2a5b4'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M34 20 L30 8 L42 16 Z' fill='#d97f92'/>
  <path d='M66 20 L70 8 L58 16 Z' fill='#d97f92'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#f9c3cd'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='40' rx='2.2' ry='3' fill='#c46b80'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='40' rx='2.2' ry='3' fill='#c46b80'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='30' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#5a2d3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='30' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#5a2d3a'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='28.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='28.5' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='37' r='3' fill='#e0899b'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='37' r='3' fill='#e0899b'/>
  <!-- tail curly -->
  <path d='M74 60 q8 -2 6 -8 q-2 -5 -6 -2' stroke='#d97f92' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='24' r='3' fill='#8fd6ff'/>
  <rect x='20' y='12' width='2' height='12' fill='#8fd6ff'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='#ffd76b'/>
  <rect x='83.5' y='9' width='1.8' height='11' fill='#ffd76b'/>
  <path d='M85.3 9 q6 1 5 6' stroke='#ffd76b' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none'/>
</svg>
